tasks.partName: Phản hồi email/yêu cầu (Respond to a Written Request)

emails.emailText:
Directions
: Respond to an email
From: George Pinkney
To: Social Committee members
Subject: Meeting
Sent: April 2, 20—
It is time for a meeting of the Social Committee. We need to start planning the annual year-end party. I would like all members of the committee to meet next Friday morning from 9 to 11 in Conference Room A. Please let me know as soon as possible if you are available to attend this meeting.
Thank you.
George Pinkney
Social Committee Chair
Directions: Respond to the
e-mail
as if you are a member of the Social Committee. In your
e-mail
, explain ONE problem and make TWO suggestions.
emails.emailHtml:
Directions: Respond to an email

From: George Pinkney

To: Social Committee members

Subject: Meeting

Sent: April 2, 20—

It is time for a meeting of the Social Committee. We need to start planning the annual year-end party. I would like all members of the committee to meet next Friday morning from 9 to 11 in Conference Room A. Please let me know as soon as possible if you are available to attend this meeting.

Thank you.

George Pinkney

Social Committee Chair

Directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you are a member of the Social Committee. In your e-mail, explain ONE problem and make TWO suggestions.
emails.directions: Respond to the email as if you are the recipient. Address the issues and questions asked.

tasks.partName: Viết bài luận quan điểm (Write an Opinion Essay)
tasks.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? It is more important to work at a job you enjoy than to make a lot of money. Support your answer with specific reasons and examples.
